_comment: The store a `npm run dev:apps` run starts from. `{{HOME}}` is replaced with
the absolute path of the copied dev-home tree by tools/dev-home/run.mjs.
Three things are seeded and nothing else. Grants, because a simulated-sandbox
run would otherwise open on thirteen 'Needs access' cards and thirteen folder
pickers; one entry on the tree's root covers every app, since coveredByGrant
is containment-based. Obsidian's configPath, because Obsidian has no standard
location at all — without it that column can only ever report
config-path-required. And a backups folder inside the tree, so saves take
backups where you can read them.
chords is deliberately absent and firstRunCompleted deliberately false: the
table should be filled by the real import running over the real files, which
is the thing being tested. deserializeStore fills in every key left out here.
The key itself is ignored — deserializeStore reads only the fields it knows.
